jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
jobs.description:
At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams
(spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own.

You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features
end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating
optimization and forecasting logic into production services
, and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation
the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production.

Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva

Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions.
As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day.

Your work will directly contribute to:

Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe
Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets
Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC)
Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses
Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD)

What You’ll Do

Priva Digital Services & product engineering
Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart
Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value
Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration

Optimization & forecasting integration
Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory
Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration

Cloud infrastructure & DevOps
Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams
Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation
Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions
Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring

What you will NOT do

This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory
You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar

Requirements

A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field
Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one
You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects)
Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript)
You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week
Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work with complex, unfamiliar systems
A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering
Curiosity, ownership, craftsmanship, and the drive to keep learning
Good communication skills, able to explain trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective

What We Offer You

💶 Excellent remuneration, competitive and aligned with experience
🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 extra at half price
🏦 Excellent pension contribution
🎓 €1,000 education budget per year
⏰ Flexible working hours, and location.
🍱 On-site canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2)
🏋️ Free onsite gym- with personal trainer.
🎉 A vibrant, open culture where you can be yourself
🌿 Human- and values-driven work, not corporate bureaucracy
🍻 Twice-weekly drinks on Thursdays and Fridays

jobs.title: Senior Platform & Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Outokumpu is accelerating the green transition as the global leader in sustainable stainless steel.

Our business is rooted in the circular economy: our products are made from 95% recycled materials and are fully recyclable. Our stainless steel is used across society—from infrastructure and mobility to household appliances.

We are committed to the 1.5°C climate target and, with up to 75% lower carbon footprint than the industry average, we help our customers reduce their emissions.

Together, we are working towards a world that lasts forever. Outokumpu employs approximately 8,200 professionals in close to 30 countries, with headquarters in Helsinki, Finland, and shares listed on Nasdaq Helsinki. Learn more at www.outokumpu.com.

What you'll do

Design, develop and manage APIs using Azure API Management (APIM)
.
Build integration solutions with Azure Integration Services
(Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Event Grid, Service Bus).
Develop secure, scalable data ingestion and event-driven integration patterns.
Implement API security, authentication, monitoring and lifecycle management.
Automate infrastructure and deployments using Terraform, Bicep and Azure DevOps CI/CD
.
Develop integration components in Python, C#, .NET, PowerShell or Node.js
.
Collaborate with Data Engineering and AI teams to support data, analytics and AI initiatives.
Contribute to integration standards, reusable frameworks and platform evolution.

What we're looking for

Several years of experience in Azure integration, API engineering or cloud data ingestion
.
Strong hands-on experience with Azure API Management
and Azure Integration Services
.
Knowledge of REST APIs, event-driven architecture and API security (OAuth2, Entra ID, Key Vault).
Experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.
Familiarity with Azure data platforms such as ADLS, Databricks, Synapse or Azure SQL
.
Strong scripting or development skills in Python, C#, .NET, PowerShell or Node.js.
Excellent problem-solving and collaboration skills.

Nice to have

Experience with AI/LLM integrations, RAG or intelligent automation.
Databricks administration and Unity Catalog knowledge.
Experience in manufacturing or other complex enterprise environments.

What We Offer

An opportunity to grow your career in a global company driving sustainable innovation.
A collaborative and inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued.
Meaningful work that contributes to a more sustainable future.
Learning and development opportunities to support your professional growth.
Flexible working arrangements, depending on the role and location.
Competitive compensation and a locally tailored benefits package.
The chance to work with international teams and experts across the organization.

Salary range in Finland: 4260 to 5330 eur. gross
. Final offer depends on candidate experience and competence.

📄 Employment Details

3-month probation period
Permanent employment contract

📬 Application

Please send your CV in English.
We appreciate your interest in joining our team and thank all applicants for their submissions. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Software Engineer for Global AI Platform in Medical Imaging
jobs.description:
Are you an (AI-native) software engineer with a passion for technology and a strong desire to work on the development of life-critical IT systems in the healthcare sector? Do you want to be part of a team that constantly challenges itself and drives innovation forward?

We are now looking for a motivated and technically skilled software engineer to join our Amplifier group. The Amplifier group is responsible for a SaaS offering called Amplifier Services, a fully managed service allowing Sectra PACS customers to easily access AI applications for clinical use. Our service offering consists of a combination of our own software products (Amplifier Platform and Connector Proxy) combined with Sectra's other products and services and the use of Azure for deployment. Through our service, we are part of an ongoing revolution within healthcare, where AI goes from being a pipe dream to a clinical reality making a difference for both patients and healthcare providers.

We're looking for someone who wants to grow in an environment where your experience is valued and where you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the successful adoption of AI in clinical practice.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain high-quality services and applications used in medical imaging workflows.
Apply AI tools (e.g., code assistants, code generators) responsibly to increase velocity without compromising quality, security, or cost.
Collaborate with product management, operations, clinicians and end-users, to translate clinical needs into robust solutions.
Own features end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, observability, documentation, and deployment.
Implement and uphold strong engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, performance profiling, etc.
Work with medical imaging standards and infrastructure (e.g., DICOM, HL7/FHIR, PACS/VNA, cloud services).
Continuously learn: evaluate new tools, frameworks, and AI capabilities; share knowledge across the team.

Location

This role is based at our headquarters in Linköping.

,

At Sectra, we hire for attitude and ability – train for skill. This means who you are is more important than your previous experiences. There are a few core abilities that are central for any role at Sectra. We always look for your willingness and ability to learn and take on new tasks fast, utilize previous experiences and quickly grasp new information. We also want you to have a strong analytical and solution-oriented mindset as we consider it to be important that you can understand and break down and solve problems.

What You Bring

Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures/algorithms, concurrency, networking, API design, software architecture.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages for software development (e.g., C# or Python) and modern software engineering tooling.
Quality mindset: automated testing, observability (metrics/logs/traces), and performance awareness.
Security and privacy literacy (secure coding, handling sensitive data).
Curiosity and learning agility; ability to adapt to new domains, tools, and AI workflows.
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, product-oriented approach.
Required: Humor and strong academic record from university and upper secondary school; please include transcripts or grade summaries in your application.
Required: Fluency in English, both spoken and written.

Most of all, we are looking for an open, passionate person who shares our values, is a true team player and will enjoy working with us at Sectra.

Nice to have

Experience with cloud services, containers, and CI/CD (AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes or serverless).
Experience in medical imaging or healthcare IT (DICOM, HL7/FHIR, imaging pipelines, PACS/VNA).
Infrastructure and reliability skills (SRE practices, performance engineering, cost).
Pursue passions outside of work, whether in sports, music, the arts, or unique hobbies.
Experience from different cultures.

What We Offer You

The opportunity to work with advanced technology that makes a real difference for patients and healthcare providers.
A dynamic and developmental work environment with great variety of tasks.
The chance to influence your own career development and specialize in areas that interest you.
A team of dedicated and experienced colleagues who will support and challenge you.

Application

The goal is for the right candidate to start as soon as possible.

We recruit on an ongoing basis. This means we encourage you to apply or contact us as soon as possible.

Depending on the role, a mandatory background security screening might be performed as part of the recruitment process at Sectra. Please reach out to the responsible hiring team if you have any questions regarding this.

Learn more about our recruitment process here.
